scanNote:
15-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (104-bet). To'q ko'k fon.

Yuqorida chapda oq 'UNIT 15'. Katta sariq qiya 'Surf the Net!'. O'NGDA SURAT: kostyumli erkak serfing taxtasida noutbuk bilan 'suzmoqda'.
ChAPDA SURAT: ayol kompyuter oldida; raqamlar: 1 - monitor (computer screen), 2 - sichqoncha (mouse), 3 - modem (klaviatura oldidagi qurilma), 4 - telefon (phone), 5 - klaviatura (keyboard).

• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 'Match these words to the numbers (1-5) in the picture, then ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Qiya: 'phone ☐ modem ☐ computer screen ☐ keyboard ☐ mouse ☐'. Ko'k qiya: 'SA: Number 3 is a keyboard, isn't it? SB: No, it isn't. It's a modem. Number 2 is a mouse, isn't it? SA: Yes, it is.'
2) 'Match the words/phrases (1-6) to the definitions (a-f).' SARIQ QUTI: 1 the Internet (ko'k strelka → c) 2 the Web 3 a web site 4 surfing the net 5 e-mail 6 downloading | a moving from one document or web site to another, to find information b copying information from a web site to your own computer c a network of computers all over the world, joined by phone lines, satellite or cable d a system linking millions of documents stored on Internet computers around the world e the place on the Internet where a company/organisation/etc stores its documents f electronic messages sent to someone over the Internet.
3) Kasseta belgisi: a) 'Listen and mark the statements as T (true) or F (false).' 1 The Internet was started in 1990. [F - namuna] 2 The Internet links computers. 3 To visit a web site, you simply enter the telephone number. 4 The main use of the Internet is to find mistakes. 5 Using the Internet is getting more expensive. b) 'Listen again and correct the false statements, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: 'The Internet wasn't started in 1990. It was started in 1968.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '104'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words/phrases (1-6) to the definitions (a-f).
exercises.explanationUz:
INTERNET LUG'ATI:

  1 the Internet → c (butun
    dunyodagi kompyuterlar tarmog'i)
  2 the Web → d (millionlab
    hujjatlarni bog'lovchi tizim)
  3 a web site → e (kompaniya
    hujjatlarini saqlaydigan joy)
  4 surfing the net → a (hujjatdan
    hujjatga o'tish)
  5 e-mail → f (elektron xabarlar)
  6 downloading → b (ma'lumotni
    o'z kompyuteringizga nusxalash)


⚠ 'THE INTERNET' va 'THE WEB':

  Internet = kompyuterlar TARMOG'I
  (texnika).
  Web (World Wide Web) = shu
  tarmoqdagi HUJJATLAR tizimi
  (sahifalar).


⚠ 'A NETWORK':

  = tarmoq.


⚠ 'TO LINK':

  = bog'lamoq.


⚠ 'TO STORE':

  = saqlamoq.


⚠ 'TO DOWNLOAD':

  = yuklab olmoq.
  ⚠ 'upload' = yuklamoq (serverga).


⚠ 'E-MAIL':

  = electronic mail - elektron
  pochta.

pairs.right: f electronic messages sent to someone over the Internet
pairs.rightUz: f Internet orqali kimgadir yuborilgan elektron xabarlar

pairs.right: b copying information from a web site to your own computer
